target.name: BlackRock Senior High Income Fund, Inc.

listed_quote.quote: BlackRock Senior High Income Fund, Inc. (NYSE:ARK), BlackRock Strategic Bond Trust (NYSE:BHD) and BlackRock Debt Strategies Fund, Inc. (NYSE:DSU) have approved the reorganization of each of ARK and BHD into DSU, with DSU continuing as the surviving fund

announcement.quote: BlackRock Advisors, LLC announced today that the Boards of Directors/Trustees of each of BlackRock Senior High Income Fund, Inc. (NYSE:ARK), BlackRock Strategic Bond Trust (NYSE:BHD) and BlackRock Debt Strategies Fund, Inc. (NYSE:DSU) have approved the reorganization of each of ARK and BHD into DSU, with DSU continuing as the surviving fund

deals.notes: Last filings that mention the deal are the Oct 8 2013 vote-reminder 425s (meeting set for Oct 25 2013) and a Dec 10 2013 N-14 post-effective amendment filing tax opinions; none states the vote result or completion. The 2014 and 2015 DEF 14As in the window are annual board-election proxies and do not mention the reorganization in the excerpts.
